name: OnlyFit: Home Workouts
summary:
Home workouts, brought to life: train with a ultra-realistic coach across **HIIT, Tabata, Interval Training, MetCon, LISS, Core Workout, Cardio Boxing, and Dance Cardio**.

Pick your session and soundtrack, then train face-to-face in VR - building strength, boosting energy, and creating a routine you’ll want to return to.
